definitions.gloss: to face each other; to sit / stand opposite one another
definitions.explanation: For two or more people or things to be positioned facing one another directly. Also used figuratively for confronting or dealing squarely with a person, problem, or one's own feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}う。
⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ→向かい合わせ：27184_mukaiawase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: We arranged the desks facing each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}って⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: The whole family sat around the dinner table facing each other and ate dinner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}さ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}うこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Confronting one's own weakness head-on is not easy for anyone.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (to face, to head toward) and ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (the reciprocal auxiliary suffix 'to do mutually'). The reciprocal nuance is essential: one-sided facing is ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧, while mutual facing is {向|む}かい{合|あ}う.

USAGE:
- Physical meaning: two people, tables, buildings, etc. positioned facing each other. Subjects are typically plural or joined by ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.
- Figurative meaning: facing up to or directly engaging with a problem, emotion, person, or one's past. Takes the object with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧+⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧.
- The て-form {向|む}かい{合|あ}って is very common as an adverbial: {向|む}かい{合|あ}って⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to talk face to face).
- ⟦{向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ→向かい合わせ：27184_mukaiawase⟧ (the noun form with -aせ ending) means 'opposite each other (in arrangement)'.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive. Partners are marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧, or both parties appear as the joint subject.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}う: to face (something) head-on
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}う: to confront a problem
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}{自身|じしん}→自分自身：27089_jibunjishin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}う: to face oneself
- {向|む}かい{合|あ}って⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit facing each other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head toward / face — one-directional, not reciprocal
- ⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧: to face / oppose — more abstract, often in formal or literary contexts
- ⟦{対峙|たいじ}→対峙：12357_taiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confront / face off — stronger, often adversarial
- ⟦{見|み}つめ→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to gaze at each other — emphasizes eye contact rather than physical position
